welcome.title: Build an app in four steps
welcome.step1Body: Tell the AI what you want to build in plain words. No coding needed.
welcome.step2Body: Watch it write a working app with real code.
welcome.step3Body: Ask for changes to colours, features or layout and see them right away.
welcome.step4Body: Publish to the web in one click and share the link.
